시편-12-1.title: 시편 12장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-12-1.exegesis: 7. his countenance-- literally, "their faces," a use of the plural applied to God, as in Ge 1:26 ; 3:22 ; 11:7 ; Is 6:8 , &c., denoting the fulness of His perfections, or more probably originating in a reference to the trinity of persons. "Faces" is used as "eyes" ( Psa 11:4 ), expressing here God's complacency towards the upright (compare Psa 34:15 , 16 ).

시편-12-2.title: 시편 12장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-12-2.exegesis: PSALM 12 Psa 12:1-8 . On title, see Introduction and see on Psa 6:1 . The Psalmist laments the decrease of good men. The pride and deceit of the wicked provokes God's wrath, whose promise to avenge the cause of pious sufferers will be verified even amidst prevailing iniquity. 1. the faithful-- or literally, "faithfulness" ( Psa 31:23 ).
